component.name: Innioasis Updater CE
component.summary: Firmware flasher and updater for Innioasis Y1 and Y2 audio players

description.p: Innioasis Updater CE (Community Edition) Neo is a cross-platform desktop application designed to flash, update, and restore Innioasis Y1 and Y2 digital audio players.

ul.li: Automatic online catalog of official, Rockbox, and community firmware releases
Dual flashing engines: MediaTek SP Flash Tool and native MTKClient backend
Guided step-by-step connection illustrations and automatic device detection
Smart scatter file parsing and recovery tools
Cross-platform support across Linux, macOS, and Windows
